assistantRules: Answer the learner's immediate navigation or support question first.
Use current visible Falowen labels and official routes only.
Do not invent pages, tabs, learner status, scores, attendance, payment status or assignment requirements.
If a route depends on level or access, explain the relevant prerequisite briefly.
For private account state, explain where to check it rather than claiming to know it.

accessStates.meaning: Registered but full campus access is not active
accessStates.nextAction: Use the setup checkpoint to start the one-time 7-day trial or complete tuition payment.
Use the campus normally during the 7-day trial.
Complete tuition payment to continue. Progress and scores are retained for 30 days after trial end.
Use Learn → Course Book to continue.

accessStates.meaning: The lesson requires Falowen Radio before workbook access
accessStates.nextAction: Complete Falowen Radio, then use Continue.

accessStates.meaning: The workbook is practice and not configured for tutor marking
accessStates.nextAction: Complete the work; do not look for a Submit tab unless the lesson explicitly provides one.

accessStates.meaning: Work may have been submitted but a marked result is not yet available
accessStates.nextAction: Check Results later; do not resubmit blindly.

levelRules.A1: Mixes foundation lessons, self-practice and teacher-marked assignments. Do not describe every workbook as a submission.
levelRules.A2: Uses lesson material, workbooks and teacher-marked submissions. Falowen Radio may gate the workbook.
levelRules.B1: Uses lesson material, workbooks and teacher-marked submissions. Falowen Radio may gate the workbook.
levelRules.B2: Self-learning track with AI support. Standard class Attendance, Exam File and Class Members tabs are intentionally hidden.
levelRules.C1: Self-learning track with AI support. Standard class Attendance, Exam File and Class Members tabs are intentionally hidden.
levelRules.C2: Advanced self-learning and AI-supported practice. Do not invent a teacher-marked assignment requirement unless the current page explicitly provides one.

troubleshooting.problem: Workbook keeps returning to Falowen Radio
troubleshooting.action: Complete the required Radio step, then use Continue.
Treat the activity as self-practice unless the page explicitly identifies teacher marking.
Check Results. Marking or synchronization may still be pending.

troubleshooting.problem: B2/C1 cannot see Attendance, Exam File or Class Members
troubleshooting.action: These class-based tabs are intentionally hidden for B2/C1 self-learning.

troubleshooting.problem: Payment was made but access has not updated
troubleshooting.action: Use the setup/account status refresh flow.
Complete tuition payment within the 30-day retention period to continue with the same stored progress and scores.
